variants.name: 手順の env に渡す

name:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: 鍵を確かめる
        run: echo "token=$DEPLOY_TOKEN"
        env:
          DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
      - run: npm run deploy
        env:
          DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
